subject: ECC review harness stood up (dormant, report-only) — its first pass found 4 VERIFIED fail-closed inversions in your #336 self-check tooling (latent: those scripts aren't wired into CI yet)
body:
Standing up an EXTERNAL review harness (affaan-m/ECC, dormant/hooks-off, run as report-only headless passes with SignalGrid fail-closed guardrails) — the owner asked for a final-pass second opinion. Its first real pass landed on your #336 self-check tooling and found fail-closed inversions in the very tooling meant to enforce fail-closedness. I VERIFIED these four against the code myself (file:line confirmed); reporting, not fixing, per the reviewer contract.

IMPORTANT SEVERITY NUANCE: classify-failure.mjs, scan-gaps.mjs and check-gate-census.mjs are STANDALONE — not npm scripts, not in preflight, not in CI (grep confirms). So these are LATENT, not live CI fail-opens. But the whole point of this tooling is to catch exactly this bug class, and it violates it, so worth fixing before you wire any of them into a gate.

VERIFIED (I read the lines):

1. classify-failure.mjs — exit contract INVERTED. The `for (const c of hits)` loop falls off the end with no process.exit, so a DIAGNOSED condition — including one that prints "BLOCKS THIS PR. Fix before merging." (blocks_pr:true) — exits 0. The UNDIAGNOSED branch (line ~117) exits 1. So the safe-unknown case fails and the known-blocking case passes: fail-OPEN direction. Anything keying on $? (a future wrapper/lane) reads it backwards. Fix: exit non-zero when any hit has blocks_pr, and keep the undiagnosed exit(1).

2. check-gate-census.mjs — covers() is bare substring: `text.includes(gate)`. A gate named in a SKIP branch counts as "run somewhere". Live example: run-live-lanes.sh:226 `skip "proof:live-fleet" ...` and validate-sim-macos.sh naming proof:live-fleet inside `[ -z "$FLEET_URL" ]` skip guards — with FLEET_URL unset (the normal state) those gates run nowhere, yet the census reports them covered. Fix: match only lines that INVOKE (e.g. pnpm run / the script path in a run position), not any mention.

3. check-gate-census.mjs:88 — `if (gate.startsWith("proof:live-")) lanes.push("live")` credits the live lane UNCONDITIONALLY, never consulting LANES.live. Register a proof:live-foo in package.json and nowhere else — reported covered. Delete run-live-lanes.sh entirely and all 8 proof:live-* still report covered. Fix: check LANES.live like every other lane instead of blanket-crediting.

4. check-gate-census.mjs --self-test — TAUTOLOGY. `wouldCatch = !Object.values(LANES).some(t => t.includes("check:__no_such_gate__"))` is always true (the fake name is in no file), so it PASSes without ever calling covers() or building the census — the exact "gate must be able to fail" rule this repo lives by, and this self-test cannot fail. It even PASSes when all four lane files are missing. Fix: the self-test should feed a real registered gate through covers() with its lane text blanked and assert it reports UNCOVERED.

The other ~10 findings (scan-gaps sh() swallowing its own errors and treated as "nothing found"; scan-gaps --self-test tautology via a synthetic finding; mangled evidence strings in KNOWN_CONDITIONS.json splitting on hyphens; report paths never exiting non-zero) I did NOT independently verify — they're plausible and same-shaped, but treat as unverified until you check. Full ECC output is on the Mac at tools/ecc-reviews/ if you want it.

This is the ECC harness earning its keep on run one. It stays dormant (zero session cost) and is invoked on demand as an advisory pass; it never certifies green — only preflight/verify:breadth do.
